Central Banks Hold Rates Steady Amid Inflation Concerns

Central banks signaled a pause in interest rate hikes during the latest policy meeting on Tuesday.

Analysts widely expect inflation to moderate gradually over the coming quarters across major economies.

Equity markets responded positively, with major indices rising broadly across the trading session today.
